packet.title: Elements to maps and back (implementation)
packet.summary: Implements element-to-map, element-to-map-plan and map-to-element in the element_map part.

body.p: After . Owns src/function_library_element_map.c, tests/function_library_element_map_test.c. element-to-map, element-to-map-plan, map-to-element ( tree builder for new trees). Done when fn-element-to-map, fn-element-to-map-plan, fn-map-to-element ≥ 95%. Spec: F&O 4.0 "Converting elements to maps". Done 2026-10-17 (): part element_map; fn-element-to-map 179/181 run (two asserts on the context value the driver leaves absent), fn-element-to-map-plan 20/20, fn-map-to-element 224/228 (two expect XQuery entity decoding, two need fn:serialize).
